title: Azure storage account schema
description: Validation rules for a StorageV2 account with platform security defaults.

storageAccount.title: Storage account
storageAccount.description: Creates a StorageV2 account in Central US with secure defaults.

instance.title: Storage account instance
instance.description: Unique identifier. Generated Azure name removes separators and must fit 3-24 lowercase letters/digits.

resource_group_instance.title: Resource group instance
resource_group_instance.description: Must match an instance declared in resource_groups.

public_network_access_enabled.title: Public network access
public_network_access_enabled.description: Disabled by default; enable only with an approved exception.

shared_access_key_enabled.title: Shared key authentication
shared_access_key_enabled.description: Disabled by default; prefer Microsoft Entra ID authentication.
